_note: Propulsion subsystem-local dimensions (owner E1). Shared numbers (prop diameter, stations, cant, motor OD, ESC pad, motor face) are read from params/params.json and subsystems/fins/params.json, never copied here. Envelopes of bought parts: every value UNVERIFIED until T-E1-MOTOR-RM measures the first motor, adapter, ESC and prop. Read by fusion/propulsion.py and make_propulsion.py.

body_len_m.note: mount face to bell top; X2814 V3 can 35 x 36 mm (maker drawing); params.json#propulsion.motor_length_m 0.036; was 0.0265 (X3108S)

base_d_m.source: E1 EST (maker drawing shows the 4 x M3 on a 19 / 25 mm cross; boss dia. not read)
base_d_m.note: stationary base boss on the canted plate; EST 32 mm covers the 25 mm cross + 3.5 mm; measure on arrival

base_h_m.source: SRC-E1-X2814-DRAWING (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2024/0305/files/X2814.jpg, read 2026-11-14; review/CLOSURE-ROUND-2026-11-14/E1.md#D-173) (M3 base holes 3.0 mm deep)
base_h_m.note: base boss height = depth of the 4 x M3 tapped holes; the bell starts 0.5 mm above it (running gap)

bell_gap_m.note: axial running gap base to bell

shaft_ahead_m.note: shaft 12 mm proud of the bell (maker drawing); sits in the adapter pilot bore

circlip_d_m.source: E1 EST (DIN 6799 for a 4 mm shaft)
circlip_d_m.note: rear shaft end and E-clip inside the plate square opening (fin_detail.mount.shaft_hole_d_m); rear shaft length of the X2814: -

circlip_h_m.note: behind the base face; the plate is 4.5 mm, so the clip never touches the tube

lead_exit_r_m.source: team/F2 wire table W-PH-<st> motor end (y 0.341 at UR)
lead_exit_r_m.note: three factory phase leads leave the base outboard; X2814 V3 leads 110 mm (maker drawing), exit position on the base: -; measure (CR-E1-18)

lead_exit_w_m.source: E1 EST (3 x 16 AWG side by side)

mass_kg.note: as listed, whether leads are included: -; the 4 x M3x8 screws 3.2 g (PRP-005) are folded into it; = params.json#propulsion.motor_mass_kg

screw_pattern_m.note: 4 x M3 on 19 / 25 mm cross (= fins mount.bolt_pattern_m)

screw_hole_depth_m.note: tapped depth in the base; M3x8 through a 4.5 mm plate engages 2.5 mm (CL-E1-SCREW-ENGAGE, zero margin)

base_d_m.note: base dia. 21 with 3 x dia. 2.7 / 4.8 counterbores on dia. 15 (maker drawing)

base_t_m.source: E1 EST (drawing: 30 mm overall - 23.5 mm post)

post_len_m.source: SRC-E1-X2814-DRAWING (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2024/0305/files/X2814.jpg, read 2026-11-14) (dia. 6 pilot 7.5 mm + 16 mm thread)
post_len_m.note: above the base; with the 10.41 mm hub and a 2.5 mm washer the nut has 10.6 mm of post (CL-E1-NUT-ENGAGE +4.6 mm over 1.0 d)

pilot_d_m.note: shaft bore of the adapter base

pilot_depth_m.source: E1 EST (shaft 12 mm proud of the bell)

screw_circle_d_m.note: 3 x M2.5x0.45 on a 15 mm circle into the bell top, 3.5 mm deep; 120 deg spacing, first at 90 deg (EST)

screw_len_m.note: M2.5x6 EST (3.5 mm base under the counterbore + 2.5 mm engagement); hole depth in the bell 3.5 mm

thread_hand_CW_motors.source: SRC-E1-X2814-DRAWING (https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/2024/0305/files/X2814.jpg, read 2026-11-14) (labels CCW (left-hand) / CW (right-hand)); E1.md D-173 applied section 3
thread_hand_CW_motors.note: LH post on the CW motors UR / LL, RH on UL / LR; whether the box holds both hands: -

nut_h_m.source: E1 EST (spinner-nut engagement need 6.0 mm; the drawn nut has a 14.5 mm thread, height: -)
nut_h_m.note: must fit the 10.6 mm of post above the washer

bore_d_m.source: APC LPAR06E ring in the 1/4 in bore

pitch_m.source: APC 11x8E (8 in), apcprop.com 2026-11-14 via E1.md D-173.6
pitch_m.note: sets the blade angle beta = atan(p / (2 pi r)) of the envelope only

blade_r_frac.source: E1 EST (APC E planform, not measured)

blade_chord_m.note: envelope for the CAD and the transport tray, not for aero (B4 uses the PER3 files)

esc._note: ESC envelope = E3's ASM-E3-ESC (45 x 20 x 6 mm in heat-shrink); lies flat on the outboard face of the ASA pad FIN-007, long side along x, FET side out, centred on the pad

size_m.note: x along the fin (slipstream), y away from the pad, z across

spares._note: bought, not flown (not in the mass roll-up); I1 orders them with the flight set

prop_11x55.source: E1 (2 E + 2 EP 11x8, D-173; key name kept for readers)
